t: This is the Falcon Estate in Battersea, a housing estate in south London. It was commissioned by Alfred Heaver, who lived from 1841 to 1901. Heaver began as a carpenter and became a builder and property developer. He built housing estates amounting to thousands of homes across south London, including the Heaver Estate in Balham. He was murdered in 1901 by a relative who held a grudge against him. The homes around you are one piece of that very large body of building work.
